name: Timeline Tracker
description: Keeps a per-chat story clock and the skills, relationships and events that began on it, and tells the story model each turn how long ago each began, so nothing that started yesterday is described as lasting weeks. Uses World State's date and time when that tracker is active. Replaces Timeline & Chronology Anchor. Add the Agent in Chat Settings → Agents → Tracker Agents for Roleplay and Game modes.
